item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 8-seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t make this exact edit with the connected Magic Hour tools: they offer generative video editing, but not speaker-following crops or a way to guarantee the original audio stays untouched.

Your edit needs:
- **9:16 vertical**, keeping all **10 seconds**
- Man centred during his question, then woman centred during her answer
- Original audio unchanged
- No captions

I haven’t started a generation or spent credits, since it could alter the footage or audio rather than simply reframe it.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
The 10-second edit was refused because your account doesn’t have enough credits, even with the free-plan model at 480p. No clip was created.

You’ll need more credits to retry the full edit. I haven’t shortened it, since you asked to keep all 10 seconds.

Keep the full 10 seconds at original speed without trimming any portion. No captions, subtitles, text, music, additional dialogue, or other overlays. Only change the framing and cut between the speakers as described.
